name: stealth-parkour-3d
description: Third-person stealth and parkour starter (Assassin's Creed-like, original): one greybox city district with climbable facades, rooftops and hay; guards who see, hear, search and call for support; a crowd to blend into; a counter-based fight when found; notoriety with posters; a viewpoint that reveals the district; and one assassination contract (a target with a routine, the strike, the escape). Built on recipes 40, 66-73 (added with their tests); behaviour scenarios + unit contracts, including a bot that completes the contract.
